key.name: rules-desktop
key.description: Used when the pointer is over the empty desktop; if none matches, the shell rules are tried. Each rule is (button number, modifiers, action id). Modifiers are a sorted '+' list of alt, ctrl, shift, super ('' for none), for example 'ctrl+shift'. The first matching rule wins.

key.name: rules-shell
key.description: Used when the pointer is over a Shell surface such as the top bar. Presses over application windows never reach the extension. Each rule is (button number, modifiers, action id). Modifiers are a sorted '+' list of alt, ctrl, shift, super ('' for none), for example 'ctrl+shift'. The first matching rule wins.

key.name: rules-overview
key.description: Used while the overview is open and enabled. Each rule is (button number, modifiers, action id). Modifiers are a sorted '+' list of alt, ctrl, shift, super ('' for none), for example 'ctrl+shift'. The first matching rule wins.

key.name: rules-app-grid
key.description: Used while the app grid is showing and enabled. Previous and next workspace turn the pages of the grid. Each rule is (button number, modifiers, action id). Modifiers are a sorted '+' list of alt, ctrl, shift, super ('' for none), for example 'ctrl+shift'. The first matching rule wins.

key.name: work-in-overview
key.description: Use the overview rules while the overview is open.

key.name: work-in-app-grid
key.description: Use the app grid rules while the app grid is showing.

key.name: wrap-workspaces
key.description: Previous on the first workspace goes to the last one, and next on the last goes to the first. Also applies to moving a window. Does not apply to app grid pages.

key.name: debug-log
key.description: For troubleshooting: write one debug line per handled mouse button press to the journal.
